groups.boundBasis: Existing public normalized control domains [0,1]; these are the approved semantic axes for hardness, string loss, unison, and inharmonicity.
groups.rationale: Use semantic controls instead of independently searching the implementation coefficients that they govern.

groups.boundBasis: Existing public normalized control domains; excluded from the approved core-tone screen and reserved for later focused calibration.
groups.rationale: Hammer noise must not manufacture contact brightness; soundboard and stereo controls are tuned after the core physical screen.

groups.boundBasis: Previously approved Issue #7 independent force calibration fixed the authoritative value at 300.
groups.rationale: Do not search force scale during the initial Level-1 QMC.

groups.boundBasis: Launch intercept, slope, and base-hardness multiplier remain fixed architecture; initial velocity always follows the legacy MIDI-velocity mapping.
groups.rationale: Keep the launch law independent from the new velocity-dependent felt/contact hardness axis.

groups.boundBasis: Structural normalized amount range [0,1]; zero preserves constant base hardness and one maps the velocity endpoints to the validated soft/hard limits.
groups.rationale: Represent velocity-dependent felt hardness independently of initial launch and hammer-noise scaling.

groups.boundBasis: Previously approved joint strike/compression calibration domain [0.0005,0.002].
groups.rationale: Search jointly with semantic hardness and effective C4 strike position.

groups.boundBasis: Retain the existing validated normalized compression cap.
groups.rationale: The approved calibration axis is compression_scale; the solver safety cap is not another tuning dimension.

groups.boundBasis: Existing validated contact endpoints and constraints; semantic hammer hardness is the Level-1 interpolation axis.
groups.rationale: Keep stiffness, mass, felt-exponent, and contact-loss endpoint values fixed to avoid redundant dimensions.

groups.boundBasis: Retain current noise/transient mapping; hammer noise is a late-stage control and cannot substitute for contact/string physics.
groups.rationale: Exclude these implementation coefficients from the initial QMC.

groups.boundBasis: Derived by the single authorized effective_strike_position_c4 axis using the production interpolation at MIDI 60 and a common offset.
groups.rationale: The bass and treble endpoints are not independent QMC dimensions; derive them together so their difference stays unchanged.

groups.boundBasis: Retain existing validated string-count and unison/strike-shape mappings; piano_string_unison is the semantic calibration axis.
groups.rationale: Keep per-string shape, offsets, and MIDI transition topology fixed in Level 1.

groups.boundBasis: Retain the existing validated geometry, junction impedance, termination delay, register transition, and fit-grid coordinates.
groups.rationale: These values define model topology and interpolation coordinates, not independent calibration dimensions.

groups.boundBasis: Pitch-specific B values remain the output of the approved reference fitter.
groups.rationale: The semantic piano_inharmonicity axis calibrates the mapping without replacing the per-key fitted table.

groups.boundBasis: Passive boundary loss is velocity-independent and per-second decay is time-normalized against string.decay_reference_midi; piano_string_damping remains the semantic loss/decay axis.
groups.rationale: Do not tune low-level loss coefficients independently of their semantic control or introduce strike-velocity dependence into passive boundary decay.

groups.boundBasis: Retain the current dispersion equation mapping and use piano_inharmonicity as the semantic calibration axis.
groups.rationale: Do not expose implementation mappings as additional QMC dimensions.

groups.boundBasis: Retain the existing validated passive-filter, damping, loss, and dispersion mappings.
groups.rationale: These coefficients implement the approved string and bridge termination equations.

groups.boundBasis: Retain the positive-impedance bridge junction and current bridge-radiation difference mapping.
groups.rationale: Do not reopen bridge transfer/radiation coefficients during core-tone screening without separate evidence.

groups.boundBasis: Retain existing ordered crossover and low-bass gate coordinates validated by the authoritative metadata generator.
groups.rationale: These values define register topology, not ordinary acoustic coefficients.

groups.boundBasis: Reference-derived soundboard fit values remain controlled by the approved fitter and regeneration path.
groups.rationale: Keep modal, Q, zone, residual, feedback, radiation, and spatial fit coefficients outside the hammer/string QMC.

groups.boundBasis: Approved architecture decision fixes the direct dry longitudinal path at 0.0; no finite search bound exists.
groups.rationale: Longitudinal modes remain in the bridge/body path and must not be added as a second dry radiator.
